options.content:
**Headline health for the perf-monorepo estate** — ECS task health, RDS/Aurora engine load, and the k6 load-test request KPIs — replayed from the live `source="perf"` federation in `gardenio-vmsingle` (pull-federated from `perf.acme.example`, epic ka-0000005085).

| Surface | Series family | Scope filter |
|---|---|---|
| ECS task health | `amazonaws_com_ECS_ContainerInsights_*` | `$ecs_cluster` |
| RDS / Aurora | `amazonaws_com_AWS_RDS_*` | `$db` |
| Load KPIs (k6) | `fastapi_sponsor_api_http_*` + `http_server_requests_seconds_*` | `$load_cluster` |

> ⚠️ **Live-data gate:** every panel sources the `perf-federation` scrape. When it is paused/down (`up{job="perf-federation"}=0`, tracked in ka-0000002619) panels show **"No data"** rather than a phantom zero — the honest-empty pattern this board shares with **DB Query Performance**. AWS/CloudWatch series carry a `quantile` label (`0`=period-min, `1`=period-max); gauges here read the period-max (`quantile="1"`) and averages are reconstructed from `_sum/_count`. For per-query cost see **DB Query Performance**; for app-side RED/traces see **Service Health** / **Distributed Traces**.

panels.title: Headline — is the estate healthy & under load?
Perf federation
panels.description: Is the perf→gardenio federation scrape live? `up{job="perf-federation"}`. Red = the scrape is down and every panel below is intentionally empty.

defaults.noValue: No data — no source=perf samples in this window: the perf-federation scrape is down, or the k6 harness is idle (ka-0000002619). Empty is not zero.

panels.title: ECS running tasks
panels.description: Running ECS tasks across `$ecs_cluster` (period-max). `RunningTaskCount{quantile="1"}`.

defaults.noValue: No data — no source=perf samples in this window: the perf-federation scrape is down, or the k6 harness is idle (ka-0000002619). Empty is not zero.

panels.title: Load request rate
panels.description:
Aggregate app request rate under load — sponsor-api + keycloak across `$load_cluster`. The headline throughput the k6 harness is driving.

Both app families are summed through ONE `{__name__=~"fastapi_...|http_server_..."}` selector: an absent keycloak half still leaves the tile reading live sponsor-api throughput (the gap the old `or vector(0)` covered), but when NEITHER family reports the result is empty and the tile shows its honest-empty noValue instead of a fabricated 0 (ka-0000006531).

defaults.noValue: No data — no source=perf samples in this window: the perf-federation scrape is down, or the k6 harness is idle (ka-0000002619). Empty is not zero.

panels.title: Load p95 latency
panels.description: 95th-percentile request latency across the load surface (sponsor-api high-resolution histogram). >1s trends orange.

defaults.noValue: No data — no source=perf samples in this window: the perf-federation scrape is down, or the k6 harness is idle (ka-0000002619). Empty is not zero.

panels.title: Load error rate
panels.description:
Share of app responses that are 4xx/5xx across the load surface (keycloak `outcome` = CLIENT_ERROR/SERVER_ERROR + sponsor-api non-2xx). Any sustained non-zero value is a load-induced failure.

Each error leg EARNS its zero from observed traffic: a missing error series falls back to `<union request rate> * 0`, not to `vector(0)`, so 0% only renders while some request traffic is actually being scraped. With no traffic visible at all every leg and the denominator are empty and the tile shows its honest-empty noValue rather than a reassuring green 0% (ka-0000006531).

defaults.noValue: No data — no source=perf samples in this window: the perf-federation scrape is down, or the k6 harness is idle (ka-0000002619). Empty is not zero.

panels.title: Peak Aurora DBLoad
panels.description: Highest average-active-sessions (`DBLoad`, period-max) across the selected `$db` instances. Above the instance vCPU count means CPU saturation.

defaults.noValue: No data — no source=perf samples in this window: the perf-federation scrape is down, or the k6 harness is idle (ka-0000002619). Empty is not zero.

panels.description: Active deployment count (a value >1 per service = a rollout in progress) and total service count per cluster (`DeploymentCount`/`ServiceCount{quantile="1"}`).

panels.title: DBLoad — average active sessions
panels.description: `DBLoad` (period-max) per instance — average active sessions on the DB engine. The single best 'how busy is Postgres' number; compare against the instance vCPU count.

panels.title: CPU utilization (avg %)
panels.description: Average CPU % per instance (`CPUUtilization`, reconstructed from `_sum/_count`). Sustained >80% on the writer means the workload needs a bigger instance or query tuning.

defaults.noValue: No data — no source=perf samples in this window: the perf-federation scrape is down, or the k6 harness is idle (ka-0000002619). Empty is not zero.

panels.title: Database connections (period-max)
panels.description: Open connections per instance (`DatabaseConnections{quantile="1"}`). Tracks pool pressure under load; a ceiling here precedes connection-refused errors app-side.

defaults.noValue: No data — no source=perf samples in this window: the perf-federation scrape is down, or the k6 harness is idle (ka-0000002619). Empty is not zero.

panels.title: Read / write latency (avg)
panels.description: Average storage read & write latency per instance (`ReadLatency`/`WriteLatency` seconds, reconstructed from `_sum/_count`). Rising latency under load = I/O saturation.

defaults.noValue: No data — no source=perf samples in this window: the perf-federation scrape is down, or the k6 harness is idle (ka-0000002619). Empty is not zero.

panels.title: IOPS — read / write (avg)
panels.description: Average read & write IOPS per instance (`ReadIOPS`/`WriteIOPS` per-second, reconstructed from `_sum/_count`). The physical I/O the workload is generating.

defaults.noValue: No data — no source=perf samples in this window: the perf-federation scrape is down, or the k6 harness is idle (ka-0000002619). Empty is not zero.

panels.title: Freeable memory (period-min)
panels.description: Lowest freeable memory per instance over each period (`FreeableMemory{quantile="0"}` bytes). Approaching zero forces swap and stalls the engine.

defaults.noValue: No data — no source=perf samples in this window: the perf-federation scrape is down, or the k6 harness is idle (ka-0000002619). Empty is not zero.

panels.title: Buffer cache hit ratio (period-min %)
panels.description: Worst-case buffer cache hit ratio per instance (`BufferCacheHitRatio{quantile="0"}` — the period MIN, so a dip is not hidden by the period average). A sustained fall under load means the working set no longer fits in RAM and reads are spilling to storage — the leading indicator before read-latency (panel above) and IOPS climb. Aurora healthy is ~100%.

defaults.noValue: No data — no source=perf samples in this window: the perf-federation scrape is down, or the k6 harness is idle (ka-0000002619). Empty is not zero.

panels.title: Disk queue depth (period-max)
panels.description: Outstanding I/O operations waiting on storage per instance (`DiskQueueDepth{quantile="1"}` — the period MAX). A queue that climbs while IOPS is flat is storage saturation: the volume cannot keep up and every query behind it stalls. Pairs with read/write latency + IOPS above to separate 'DB is busy' from 'DB is I/O-bound'.

defaults.noValue: No data — no source=perf samples in this window: the perf-federation scrape is down, or the k6 harness is idle (ka-0000002619). Empty is not zero.

panels.title: Deadlocks per second
panels.description: Deadlocks/sec per instance (`Deadlocks{quantile="1"}`). Any sustained non-zero value is a contention bug the load is surfacing.

defaults.noValue: No data — no source=perf samples in this window: the perf-federation scrape is down, or the k6 harness is idle (ka-0000002619). Empty is not zero.
